pitch_01_hook.text: An oncology coordinator spends four hours per pre-screen—and one missed steroid conversion triggers a dangerous IRB protocol deviation.

pitch_02_trap.text: Marcus Vance takes Dexamethasone two milligrams BID. Naive LLMs see four milligrams, check the ten-milligram ceiling, and falsely clear him.

pitch_03_swarm.text: TrialSwarm coordinates five agents on an Antigravity swarm. Extractor and Phenotyper parse protocol and EHR in parallel. Rule R1 converts Dexamethasone to twenty-six point seven milligrams Prednisone equivalent.

pitch_04_verifier.text: Verdict: Contraindicated. The Verifier enforces Rule R6: every claim is line-anchored to source text, blocking hallucinations before CRC sign-off.

pitch_05_close.text: One hundred percent accuracy on one hundred twenty cases. Zero-cost deterministic compute. Built, shipped, and live.
